text: I feel a sense of curiosity as I pass through these sleek, modern corridors and enter a space dedicated to research and development. The bold letters "R+D" and the vibrant colors awaken in me a sense of possibility, as if knowledge and innovation are tangible forces humming in the air. Surrounded by screens and creative displays, I am reminded how human progress is shaped by our collective inquiry and inventive spirit. There is an undercurrent of excitement—here, ideas are tested and explored, the boundaries of what we know are gently pushed outward.
